_note: Example shape. Fill from the interview. 'units' is the person's money unit.
floor: Ten units logged in Block 1 before anything else opens
miss_rule: The morning after a missed floor day, the cost from the interview is paid before the first unit. Then the day runs normally. A miss is logged X and never argued with.
if_then: When the clock says 07:30, I do the first unit within 60 seconds.
When a call stings, I stand, take two physiological sighs, and dial the next number before I sit.
When someone asks for a build during a work block, I say 'after the block' and do the next unit.
phone: Call-only focus from the first block to the hard stop; the interrupt line and the protected people ring through. The phone sleeps in the kitchen from 20:15.

letters.F: full day: every full_day target met

decisions: Three X in a week: the floor is too high; lower it on the rest day.
Readiness under 3 three days running: cut the lift to two exercises and move lights out earlier by 30 min.
The one number two weeks behind pace: change the weekly plan, not the ninety-day goal.
